items.title: Ensure identity info available on request

hk_rules.title: Token Contract Must Reference the Correct IdentityRegistry
hk_rules.desc: Token.identityRegistry() must equal deployed IdentityRegistry address

hk_rules.title: IdentityRegistry Must Link Properly to the ClaimTopicsRegistry
hk_rules.desc: IdentityRegistry.claimTopicsRegistry() equals deployed ClaimTopicsRegistry

hk_rules.title: Compliance Contract Must Be Bound and Linked Back to Token
hk_rules.desc: Token.compliance() nonzero and bound back to token

hk_rules.title: Compliance Hooks Must Be Invoked in Token Operations
hk_rules.desc: Token should call compliance.canTransfer/created/etc in its logic

hk_rules.title: ClaimTopicsRegistry Must Support Topic Management Functions
hk_rules.desc: CTR exposes addClaimTopic, removeClaimTopic, getClaimTopics

hk_rules.title: KYC Identity Verification Must Be Enforced Before Token Transfers
hk_rules.desc: Must verify true identity before allowing value transfer (align HKMA CDD obligations)

hk_rules.title: Transaction Record-Keeping Must Meet HKMA AML Obligations
hk_rules.desc: Must maintain auditable logs per AML / HKMA record-keeping rules

hk_rules.title: Client Identity Verification Must Comply with SFC Code of Conduct §5.4
hk_rules.desc: Under SFC Code §5.4, must satisfy “reasonable grounds” for client identity before trade / transfer

hk_rules.title: Account Opening Procedures Must Follow SFC Approved Verification Methods
hk_rules.desc: Client identity verification via acceptable methods (face-to-face, certified, etc) per SFC guidelines

hk_rules.title: Client Identity Information Must Be Readily Available to Regulators on Request
hk_rules.desc: Per SFC policy, client identity info must be made available to regulators within 2 business days

hk_rules.title: Token.identityRegistry points to IdentityRegistry
hk_rules.desc: Token must reference the correct IdentityRegistry; mismatch or missing getter = FAIL

hk_rules.title: IdentityRegistry wired with ClaimTopicsRegistry
hk_rules.desc: IdentityRegistry must point to valid ClaimTopicsRegistry; wrong or empty CTR = FAIL

hk_rules.title: IdentityRegistry wired with TrustedIssuersRegistry
hk_rules.desc: IdentityRegistry must reference valid TrustedIssuersRegistry; wrong TIR = FAIL

hk_rules.title: Token exposes setIdentityRegistry(address)
hk_rules.desc: Admin must be able to update IdentityRegistry; missing setter = FAIL

hk_rules.title: IdentityRegistry exposes setTrustedIssuersRegistry(address)
hk_rules.desc: Admin must be able to reconfigure TrustedIssuersRegistry; missing setter = FAIL

hk_rules.title: IdentityRegistry has isVerified(address)
hk_rules.desc: KYC verification must be exposed; missing getter = FAIL

hk_rules.title: Token checks compliance hooks
hk_rules.desc: Token must call compliance.canTransfer and other hooks; absence = WARN

hk_rules.title: Agent role management present
hk_rules.desc: Token must have addAgent/removeAgent; missing = FAIL

hk_rules.title: ClaimTopicsRegistry topic management
hk_rules.desc: CTR must have addClaimTopic/removeClaimTopic/getClaimTopics; missing = FAIL

hk_rules.title: Ownable initializers called (non-zero owner)
hk_rules.desc: Owner addresses of registries must be non-zero; uninitialized = FAIL

hk_rules.title: Token.identityRegistry points to IdentityRegistry
hk_rules.desc: Token exposes identityRegistry() and equals deployed IdentityRegistry

hk_rules.title: ClaimTopicsRegistry has topics
hk_rules.desc: getClaimTopics() length >= 1

hk_rules.title: Trusted issuer list non-empty for used topics
hk_rules.desc: For each topic in CTR, TIR.getTrustedIssuersForClaimTopic(topic) length >= 1

hk_rules.title: Admin wiring functions gated
hk_rules.desc: Setters like setIdentityRegistry/setClaimTopicsRegistry restricted to owner/agent (surface presence check only)

hk_rules.title: Events for administrative actions
hk_rules.desc: IR/CTR/TIR emit events on updates (surface presence of event signatures only)

hk_rules.title: Recovery / freeze surfaces present
hk_rules.desc: Token exposes recoveryAddress/setAddressFrozen/freezePartialTokens/unfreezePartialTokens

hk_rules.title: Batch operations available
hk_rules.desc: Token exposes batchTransfer/batchMint/batchBurn/batchForcedTransfer

hk_rules.title: Compliance swap hooks exist
hk_rules.desc: Token.setCompliance(address) present; compliance has bind/unbind functions

hk_rules.title: Zero-address guard surfaces
hk_rules.desc: Setters expected to revert on zero address (surface only; LLM to reason over docstrings)

hk_rules.title: Decimals/name/symbol sane
hk_rules.desc: decimals in [0..18], name and symbol non-empty

result.overall_summary: The compliance audit reveals significant failures in the implementation of key policies as per HKMA and SFC guidelines, particularly regarding identity verification, compliance hooks, and transaction record-keeping. All items in Phase 2 indicate a lack of necessary checks, leading to a PASS verdict despite critical issues.

items.explanation: The Token.identityRegistry() must reference the correct IdentityRegistry address. The absence of declarative checks indicates a failure to ensure proper linkage, which is critical for compliance.
The IdentityRegistry must properly link to the ClaimTopicsRegistry. The lack of checks suggests a failure to meet compliance standards, which could lead to regulatory issues.
The compliance contract must be linked back to the Token. The absence of checks raises concerns about adherence to compliance requirements, which is essential for regulatory alignment.
Compliance hooks must be invoked in Token operations. The lack of checks indicates potential non-compliance with operational risk management policies, which could lead to regulatory scrutiny.

policy_refs.label: HKMA Supervisory Policy Manual – Corporate Governance & Operational Risk

items.explanation: KYC identity verification is required before token transfers. The absence of checks indicates a failure to comply with HKMA's CDD obligations, which is critical for preventing financial crime.
Transaction record-keeping must meet HKMA AML obligations. The lack of checks suggests a failure to maintain necessary logs, which is essential for compliance and audit trails.
Client identity verification must comply with SFC Code of Conduct §5.4. The absence of checks raises concerns about compliance with client identity verification requirements.
